chapters.label: Greeting & Introduction
chapters.summary: Agent welcomes the customer and introduces themselves and the bank.

chapters.label: Problem Statement
chapters.summary: Customer explains their request to open a checking account linked to their existing credit card.

chapters.label: Identity Verification
chapters.summary: Agent requests and confirms the customer's date of birth for security verification.

chapters.label: Investigation & Discussion
chapters.summary: Agent explains the differences between credit and debit accounts, linking process, and usage.

chapters.label: Options & Explanation
chapters.summary: Agent discusses fees, security features, ATM access, and other account details.

chapters.label: Resolution & Next Steps
chapters.summary: Customer decides to proceed, and agent outlines the setup process and timeline.

chapters.label: Upsell/Offer
chapters.summary: Agent mentions a savings account promotion as an additional offer.

chapters.label: Closing
chapters.summary: Agent finalizes the setup, confirms email delivery, and concludes the call.
